scene_summary: An ivory-ground illustration places a large blush-and-cream creature at the left opposite a smaller gray, pointed-eared face at the right. An upright rust, turquoise and blue rectangle sits behind a curling cream form and its broad lavender underside. The central ivory opening gives the composition breathing room, but the left-hand cluster contains many interleaved contours and mottled color transitions.
usable_surfaces: Broad lavender sweep beneath the cream hook, crossing the mottled rectangle

detected_objects.label: Lavender underside sweeping beneath the cream hook across the painted rectangle
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A continuous pale lavender band emerges beneath the cream curl, bulges along the rectangle's right edge, then sweeps down and left across its blue lower portion. Its lower arc extends beyond the rectangle into ivory. Cream foreground contours interrupt the inner edge. The mapped region follows the lavender underside rather than enclosing the entire hook, rectangle or surrounding creature fragments.

effect_material.observation: Mottled lavender, pink and blue color forms a broad curved band beneath an opaque-looking cream curl. The band crosses a granular rust-to-blue rectangle; interrupted contours and blended color establish visible pictorial layers, without specular reflections or evidence of physical thickness.

effect_editorial.source_observation: The source pixels directly show a layered digital illustration/collage: overlapping fantasy creatures with pointed ears, horns, wings and curling forms surround a central rectangle of orange, turquoise and blue painterly textures. Loose black sketch lines, translucent shapes and pale cream negative space form the artwork itself. No product interface, tool demonstration, sponsored advertisement or administrative CTA is visible. The pixels establish a creative work, but not its authorship, title or collection identity; the saved-note attribution is not independently verified.
effect_editorial.plate_observation: Mottled lavender, pink and blue color forms a broad curved band beneath an opaque-looking cream curl. The band crosses a granular rust-to-blue rectangle; interrupted contours and blended color establish visible pictorial layers, without specular reflections or evidence of physical thickness.
effect_editorial.brief_quote: A cream hook with lavender underside bridges the larger group to a displaced upright rust-and-turquoise rectangle; its broad lavender overlap keeps thin contours as others dissolve.
effect_editorial.why_behavior: The inspected source and this plate both use overlapping forms and translucent color, making layered depth technically relevant. However, separating the lavender band from the rectangle would turn deliberately blended contour crossings into detached planes and weaken the visible bridge.
effect_editorial.why_input: Pointer motion could explore layer separation locally, but the image supplies no reason to tie these fixed overlaps to pointer movement or device tilt. A stationary source window preserves the relationship without sensor input.
effect_editorial.why_not_none: The undisturbed plate already exposes the overlap through color and contour interruption. Parallax adds motion rather than useful evidence and risks opening artificial gaps at the cream and lavender boundaries.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Two creature groupings and one saturated upright rectangle dominate against a large ivory field. The open center prevents overall crowding, but the left cluster is illustration-dense rather than minimal expressionism. One tightly mapped lavender sweep is useful; additional bindings would fragment the same composition.

effects_editorial_context.brief: Landscape digital collage on ivory. A larger blush broad-muzzled face with oval eyes, long ears and cream lobes faces a smaller gray pointed-eared face with pink eyes, dark muzzle and fine whiskers across open ivory. A cream hook with lavender underside bridges the larger group to a displaced upright rust-and-turquoise rectangle; its broad lavender overlap keeps thin contours as others dissolve.
effects_editorial_context.aesthetic_thesis: An imagined landscape of interlocking cartoon-creature silhouettes, with compressed overlaps opening into a few deliberate pockets of negative space.
